name: ETERNAL WORLD ~Tatta Hitotsu no Kiseki~
original_name: ETERNAL WORLD～たったひとつの奇跡
source:
The Starlights have been absent from school because of work, and Usagi is feeling nervous. One night, the pager rings, showing a mysterious number.

Usagi/Seiya, plus platonic Usagi/Haruka.
